notes.title: Patch Notes - March 24, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Team Digital Toilet.  

Thank you for always playing our game!  

Here are the [b]patch notes for March 24, 2025[/b]:  

[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where the [b]Giga-Ink[/b] achievement was unlocked immediately upon reaching the final boss. Now, as originally intended, you must [b]defeat the final boss without any upgrades[/b] to unlock the achievement.  
[*]Slightly adjusted the sprites for various laser effects.  
[*]Adjusted coin balance. Previously, players received more than enough coins even after upgrading, which made gameplay repetitive too quickly. To address this, we have [b]slightly reduced the coin drop rate[/b].  
[/olist]

Thank you as always!  
- Team Digital Toilet -

notes.title: January 3rd. (GMT) Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Team Digital Toilet.
Thank you for your interest and playing our game.

Here are the patch notes for today, January 3rd.

[h1]Reforming Tutorial[/h1]
We felt that the tutorial needed to be more "Tutorial", so we've made some changes.
This will also change the structure of the starting room.
[list]
[*] The tutorial and the starting room will be separated. You'll be able to jump back quickly.
[*] We've changed the tutorial to a more friendly, step-by-step approach.
[/list]

[h1]Additional Details[/h1]
[list]
[*] In-game progress is now displayed when you move to the next stage and when you die.
[*] Made changes to allow the mouse to move off-screen in the game.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Slightly nerfed “Strength” related traits.
[*] The “Burn” debuff has been buffed. It should no longer be completely negligible.
[*] The number of stages in Chapter 1 has been nerfed slightly.
[*] The fist damage of the Chapter 1 boss has been lowered.
[/list]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug when rewards appear in the safe, where quickly grabbing the rewards as soon as they appear could result in all rewards being obtained.
[*] Fixed a bug where power from traits could stack and increase in certain situations
[/list]

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Chapter 3 bosses
[*] Additional Traits
[*] Balancing
[/list]

Thank you!
- Team Digital Toilet -

notes.title: December 24th Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the team Digital Toilet.
First of all, thank you for playing our game!

Here are the patch notes for today, December 24th.

[h1]New Traits Added[/h1]
- Nine new traits is added.

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
- Chapter 2 bosses have been buffed (increased health, added normal monster summoning patterns)

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- Default to 16:9 resolution, other resolutions will result in a letterbox.
- Fixed a bug where the “Master of Evasion” achievement would unlock if you didn't dash in the tutorial room. 
- Various UI fixes.
- Added readability and more detailed numbers to talent descriptions.

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
- Tutorial reorganization
- Added 3 chapter bosses
- More traits
- [b]Balancing[/b]

Thank you!
- Team Digital Toilet -

[h1]HotFix[/h1]
- Fixed Volume Slider Reset Issue.

notes.title: December 18th 1.1.0 ver Patch NoteDecember 18th 1.1.0 ver Patch Note
notes.notes:
This is the first patch history for InKing.
Thank you so much for playing our game!

[h1]New additions[/h1]
- Added permanent buffs (shop system)
	[list]
[*] You get coins for clearing each stage and opening safes.
[*] 	You can collect these coins to permanently power up your inking.
[*] 	Currently only local saves are supported.
[/list]
- Added new talents “Inkredible”, “Ink Supplement”, and “Ink Bleeding”
- Added bubble pop ink sound
- Added Spanish and Russian
	[list]
[*] We've used AI for translation, so please feel free to let us know if you find any inconsistencies.
[/list]

[h1]Convenience[/h1]
- Added dash availability indicator above player health bar
- Added mouse click interaction for inventory
- Fixed attack button being able to continue attacking when held down
- Added differential attack cooldowns based on number of attacks
- Added skill positions switching feature
- Changed the color of the skill window scroll
	[list]
[*] The stat upgrade scroll and the skill window scroll are the same color, which can be confusing.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
- Utility Ultimate Renewal
	[list]
[*] Attack speed has been increased and the attack has been changed to a 6-hit attack.
[*] 	The best synergy will be achieved by holding down the attack key.
[*] 	Due to the overwhelming attack speed, the duration will be reduced from 10 seconds to 5 seconds.
[/list]
- Inkluenza damage increased.
	[list]
[*] Before: 2 per tick 
[*] 	After: 3 per tick
[/list]
- Hemoglobink recovery increased.
	[list]
[*] Before: 1 healing every 6 to 7 hits
[*] 	After: 1 healing every 3 to 4 hits
[/list]

[h1]Text and design changes[/h1]
- Revised warning display design
- Improved description of "Bottomless Pit"
- Added effects for the "Sealed" trait

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where bosses would retain a red image when dying in Rage Mode
- Fixed a bug where if a Chapter 1 boss died while charging, the charge judgment would remain on their corpse
- Fixed a bug where a common enemy's instant death acknowledgment would also apply to an elite enemy when both the common and elite enemies were hit together
- Fixed a bug where boss health bars would not disappear upon player death

[h1]Known issue[/h1]
- Text out of script issue when applying Spanish and Russian
- Issue with subtle sound when sound value is reduced to 0
- Sound scrollbar handle disappearing issue - reappears after one interaction

[h1]Next Roadmap (in 2024)[/h1]
- Add new traits
- Add a third stage
- Add boss rush

Thank you for your support ( _ _ ) 
- Team Digital Toilet -
